name: fluid-cursor
title: Fluid Cursor
blurb: Fluid simulation following cursor and touch movements.
description: Full-screen WebGL fluid dynamics rendering particles driven by velocity, pressure, and vorticity fields. Responds to mouse and touch input with color cycling.
use_when: Interactive backgrounds for premium landing pages, portfolios, or experiences where GPU is available.
avoid_when: On low-end devices or when GPU resources are limited — continuous WebGL rendering is CPU/GPU expensive.
a11y: Interactive via mouse/touch only, not keyboard accessible. Fixed positioning overlays content and has pointer-events-none by default.
